summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default False) and a static render_speed method, and render() returns speed text when the total is unknown and show_speed is on. The module-level track() gained a trailing show_speed=True option that is passed to TaskProgressColumn. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total; the task total stays None. Added a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line, added test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the two ValueError assertions for track(5) and progress.track(5). Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified; the speed values were checked by hand only.
